html: Not really. The ISS is no where near as slapped together as the Alpha station from Valerian. Its more of a Ship of Theseus kinda thing. Secions have been added and decommissioned to the point where you could seriously question if its the same thing as when it started, and its role is much more ceremonial than that of Alpha (which is supposed to be a functioning colony).
